---
title: "diffsplice"
format: html
editor: visual
params:
  padj: 0.05
  dpsi: 0.15

---

## setup

## directories and files

Libraries
```{r}
library("ggplot2")
```


```{r}
## directories
# repo root
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

# test diffsplice results dir
test_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "test_files")

## files
diffsplice_results_file <- file.path(test_dir, "diffsplice_Whole_Blood_vs_AML.tsv")

```

Read in files
```{r}
diffsplice_results <- readr::read_tsv(diffsplice_results_file) 
```

Filter for differential splicing results within padj and significance thresholds
```{r}
filtered_diffsplice_results <- diffsplice_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    p_adj < params$padj,
    abs(dPSI) > params$dpsi
  ) |>
  # rank significant diff splice events by abs(dPSI)
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(dPSI)))
```

Plotting

### Plot volcano plot of differentially spliced events

Transform filtered events dataframe for volcano plot

```{r make_volcanoplot_df}
# log-transform p-values for volcano plot
# create dataframe of values for volcano plot
for_plot_p_dPSI_table <- filtered_diffsplice_results |>
  # take the negative log of p_adj for volcano plot
  dplyr::mutate(
    minus_log_padj = -log10(p_adj)
    ) |>
   # select only relevant columns for plotting
   dplyr::select(pos_id, dPSI, p_adj, minus_log_padj, gene_names) |>
   # Filter for unique row values for plotting
   dplyr::distinct() |>
  # assign columns colors for volcano plot
  dplyr::mutate(
    colors = dplyr::case_when(
      dPSI > params$dpsi & minus_log_padj > -log10(params$padj) ~ "sig_and_diff_increase",
      dPSI < -params$dpsi & minus_log_padj > -log10(params$padj) ~ "sig_and_diff_decrease"
    )
  )

# rank significantly differentially spliced genes by dPSI magnitude
top_15_genes <- for_plot_p_dPSI_table |>
  dplyr::filter(p_adj < params$padj) |>
  dplyr::arrange(abs(dPSI)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:15)

# add gene label column
for_plot_p_dPSI_table <- for_plot_p_dPSI_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(gene_label = ifelse(
    gene_names %in% top_15_genes & 
      colors %in% c("sig_and_diff_increase", "sig_and_diff_decrease"),
    gene_names,
    ""))

# print columns and one row as an example of final table contents
for_plot_p_dPSI_table |> head(n = 1)
```

Plot
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| #| fig-height: 8

EnhancedVolcano::EnhancedVolcano(
  for_plot_p_dPSI_table,
  lab = for_plot_p_dPSI_table$gene_label,
  x = "dPSI",
  y = "p_adj",
  title = "Volcano plot of reference and query group diff splicing",
  subtitle = "",
  legendLabels = c(
    "NS", 
    "deltaPSI > 10%", 
    "FDR < 0.05", 
    "deltaPSI > 10% and FDR < 0.05"),
    pCutoff = params$padj,
    pCutoffCol = "p_adj",
    FCcutoff = params$dpsi,
    pointSize = 1.0,
    labSize = 6.0,
    xlim = c(-1,1),
    ylim = c(0,5),
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    xlab = "deltaPSI",
    ylab = "-Log(FDR)"
    ) 

```
